cohort: 8370 patients who underwent C-sections between January 1, 2018, and December 31, 2020, at Zeynep Kamil Maternity and Children's Training and Research Hospital.
finding: The study found a 2.3% SSI rate among the participants, with emergency C-section, BMI >30 kg/m2, and multifilament skin closure being the most common features observed in the SSI group.
